services.name: Opening Exhibits 2020
services.desc: DMMDT has added 4 new dollhouses to the collection! We’re very excited to share the work of Mariana Cameron and Jude Ersery as well as countless additional miniature artists. Some toys are just classics. We’ve assembled some staff and visitors favorites to share with you! DMMDT is currently fundraising for an elevator so we can expand our display space. Much of this space is slated to be toy displays. Dolls are a great window into history. Enjoy some favorites like Shirley Temple and Chatty Cathy as well as some lesser known dolls from the DMMDT
